gloss.text: Two or more unpleasant people are fighting each other; like rats in a sack

etymology.text:
Literally, "the frog fucked the viper", a folk proverb. The frog represents envy, and the viper represents treachery. This phrase was first recoded on the Internet in 2012 or 2013.
Cognate with Russian еба́ла жа́ба гадю́ку (jebála žába gadjúku). Compare with Slovak žabo-myšie vojny (“wars of the frog and mouse”).
